name: babeldub
description: AI localization and dubbing of any game: translate voice-over and text, re-voice every line in the original character's own voice with local voice-cloning TTS, repack into native engine formats.

interface.shortDescription: Dub games into your language in the original characters' voices
interface.longDescription: BabelDub localizes a game from its folder: it finds voice-over and text tables, translates them and re-voices every line with local voice-cloning models so each character keeps the same timbre, emotion and delivery in the new language. The result is repacked into the engine's native formats and installed with a backup and one-command rollback. Voice work needs a local NVIDIA GPU; in cloud chats only text translation is available.
defaultPrompt: Localize the game in D:\Games\MyGame into Russian with dubbing in the original voices
Check my environment for BabelDub voice cloning
Roll back the BabelDub localization of my game
